subject.title: fix(codex): guard state-dependent registration for lightweight CLI runtime

question: Should this zero-diff PR close after a maintainer confirms the lazy-state implementation’s introducing commit and release containment, or should the contributor replace it with focused regression coverage?
rationale: The branch is empty and the earlier defect is gone, but repository policy requires concrete git-history and release provenance before an implemented-on-main close; the review sandbox could not execute those commands.

options.title: Confirm provenance and close
options.body: Identify the current lazy-state implementation commit and its first containing release or main-only timestamp, then close this PR as implemented on main.

options.title: Request test-only replacement
options.body: Ask the contributor to add a focused reduced-runtime registration test if maintainers want durable regression coverage beyond the existing implementation.
